correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the harmonic Schwarzian difference exactly from the pre-Schwarzian gap Q. A direct second-order Schwarz-Pick argument bounds the only new Omega-double-prime term, while the source sharp bound controls Q. The cubic-shear witness is globally univalent by the source realization lemma, balanced because its dilatation image is kD, has pre-Schwarzian norm O(k^2), and gives a direct 8/27 k^2 lower Schwarzian defect. The M=0 case follows from the exact bar-z derivative identity for P_F.
